title_candidates: OpenAI Partner Network turns AI adoption into a vendor choice
summary: OpenAI launched a partner program backed by $150 million and a goal to train 300,000 certified consultants. The reader action is to ask better vendor questions.

primary_source.title: Introducing the OpenAI Partner Network
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI launched the OpenAI Partner Network for companies that build, sell, and deliver AI solutions with OpenAI.
OpenAI said it is investing $150 million to support the partner ecosystem.
The company said it aims to train and enable 300,000 certified consultants by the end of 2026.
The partner page lists participating firms and describes apply, enable, and grow stages for organizations that want to join.

prerequisites: One AI project or workflow your team is considering

steps.instruction: Open the OpenAI Partner Network page and scan the listed partner categories.
Write the work outcome you actually want, such as fewer support escalations or faster document review.
Ask whether your need is strategy, system integration, data cleanup, agent design, security review, or staff training.
If you talk to a vendor, ask for one similar deployment, the review checkpoints, the data-access boundary, and the measurement plan.
Do not approve a pilot until the success metric and human owner are written down.
